P.name: Living Vengeance
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Varus''' kills an enemy, he gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|{{pp|10 to 20|1;7;13|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and {{sti|{{as|ability power}}}} equal to {{as|11% of his '''total bonus''' attack speed}} for {{pp|5 to 11 for 4|1 to 16}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent unit kills.
P.description2: '''Varus''' also gains ''Living Vengeance's'' bonuses upon scoring a {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}}, which empowers it for the same duration to grant him {{as|30% '''bonus''' attack speed}} as well as {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} and {{as|ability power}} equal to {{as|33% of his '''total bonus''' attack speed}}, and an increased attack speed cap of {{fd|3.33}}. ''Living Vengeance's'' empowerment may only be refreshed by subsequent champion takedowns.

Q.name: Piercing Arrow
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Varus''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% for up to 4 seconds to increase ''Piercing Arrow's'' {{sti|range}} over the first {{fd|1.5}} seconds and its  effects over the first {{fd|1.25}} seconds of the channel.
Q.description2: ''Piercing Arrow'' can be recast within the duration. If the charge completes without reactivation, ''Piercing Arrow'' is cancelled and refunds {{sti|mana|{{as|50% of the mana cost}}}}.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Varus''' fires a piercing arrow in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. The damage of the arrow as well as any detonated ''{{ai|Blighted Quiver|Varus|Blight}}'' stacks are both increased by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0 to 50 for 6|0 to 1.25|formula=2% per 0.05 seconds. ''This is capped at 1.25 seconds.''}}, and the arrow's damage is reduced by {{pp|type=number of enemies hit|key=%|0 to 60 for 5;67|0 to 5|formula=0% + (15% per enemy hit). ''This is capped at a maximum of 67%.''}}.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|80/1.5 to 360/1.5|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120/1.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 360}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Reduced Damage|{{ap|80/1.5*0.33 to 360/1.5*0.33|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(120/1.5)*0.33|round=2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Reduced Damage|{{ap|80*0.33 to 360*0.33}} {{as|(+ {{ap|120*0.33|round=2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|16 to 12}}|Starts post-effect, after charge ends the cooldown is reduced equal to the charge duration}}

W.name: Blighted Quiver
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Varus'''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Blight'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. '''Varus' ''' {{tip|abilities}} detonate all ''Blight'' stacks on affected enemies hit.
W.description2:
{{sbc|Blight:}} For each stack consumed, the target is dealt {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. If the stacks were consumed with ''{{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'', this damage is increased by {{#var:q_mod}}. This damage is capped at {{ap|360/3}} per stack against {{tip|monsters}}, for a total cap of 360 at maximum stacks.

Additionally, each stack consumed against a {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}} reduces the {{sti|'''remaining''' cooldowns}} of '''Varus' ''' basic abilities by 13% of each of their '''total''' cooldowns, up to a {{ap|13*3}}% cooldown reduction per target. If the stacks were consumed with ''{{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'', the cooldown reduction is increased by {{#var:q_mod}}, up to a {{pp|13*3 to 13*3*1.5|0 to 1.25 by 0.125|key=%|type=[[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20px|border]] Piercing Arrow's charge time|formula=39% + 1.95% per 0.125 seconds. ''This is capped at 1.25 seconds.''|round1=3|showtype=false}} cooldown reduction per target from consuming maximum stacks against them.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage per Stack|{{as|{{ap|3 to 5}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.3}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health)}}|Bonus Magic Damage at Max Stacks|{{as|{{ap|3*3 to 5*3}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1.3*3}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health)}}}}
{{st|[[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20px|border|link=]] Maximum Bonus Magic Damage per Stack|{{as|{{ap|3*1.5 to 5*1.5}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1.3*1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health)}}|[[File:Varus Piercing Arrow.png|20px|border|link=]] Maximum Bonus Magic Damage at Max Stacks|{{as|{{ap|3*3*1.5 to 5*3*1.5}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1.3*3*1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health|health)}}}}
W.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Varus'''' next ''{{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'' within {{fd|5.5}} seconds is empowered to deal {{as|'''additional bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}}, increased by {{#var:q_mod}}. This damage is capped at 360 against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling3: {{st|Active Minimum Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|6 to 14}}% of target's '''missing''' health}}|Active Maximum Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|6*1.5 to 14*1.5}}% of target's '''missing''' health}}}}
W.description4: If '''Varus''' does not cast ''{{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'', ''Blighted Quiver'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or when he dies. ''Blighted Quiver'' can be cast during the first {{fd|0.85}} seconds of ''{{ais|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'' charge, and will be placed on full cooldown after the charge ends even if ''{{ai|Piercing Arrow|Varus}}'' is not recast.
W.description5: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Varus''' ends ''Blighted Quiver'' and places it on a 1-second cooldown.
W.description6: ''Blighted Quiver's active and recast can both be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
W.cooldown: {{tt|40|Starts after the effect is used with Piercing Arrow}}

E.name: Hail of Arrows
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Varus''' fires a hail of arrows at the target location that land after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
E.description2: The area then becomes desecrated for 4 seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies within and inflicting them with {{tip|Grievous Wounds}}.

R.name: Chain of Corruption
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Varus''' unleashes a tendril of corruption in the target direction that infects the first enemy champion hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for 2 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. Over the first {{tt|{{fd|1.75}} seconds|Estimated, see notes for specific stack application timings}} of the root, they are also inflicted with maximum stacks of ''{{ai|Blighted Quiver|Varus|Blight}}''.
R.description2: Upon impact, the tendril roots into the ground from where the target was hit, seeking out nearby enemy {{tip|champions}} that are in the immediate area. If a target does not leave the area within 2 seconds, they subsequently become infected as well, taking the same damage and effects. A new tendril is then spread out from the infected target that is closest to a nearby uninfected enemy champion. The infection can spread repeatedly until there are no new targets.
R.description3: ''The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be caught by the tendril.''
